lines.en: I spin slowly with the current.
Cold water pushes me down.

lines.zh: 我在珊瑚礁间一开一合。
lines.en: I open and close between the corals.
The frozen trench carries me forward.

lines.zh: 我飘过一道海沟的边缘。
lines.en: I drift past the rim of a trench.

lines.zh: 触手拖在身后，像一串星。
lines.en: My tentacles trail behind like a string of stars.

lines.zh: 我不划水，只让海流带我。
lines.en: I do not swim; the current carries me.

lines.zh: 温水的沟里，我浮得更高。
lines.en: In warm water I float a little higher.
I pulse once and move half a block.

lines.zh: 深海的压力把我压得扁扁的。
lines.en: Deep pressure flattens my bell.

lines.zh: 我从两块礁石之间溜过去。
lines.en: I slip between two blocks of coral.

lines.zh: 光从上面漏下来，我追着它。
lines.en: I chase the light leaking from above.

lines.zh: 我的伞盖在水里轻轻鼓动。
lines.en: My bell swells gently in the water.

lines.zh: 鱼群穿过我，我一点也不躲。
lines.en: Fish pass through me and I never dodge.

lines.zh: 我把触手收短，才不会被礁石挂住。
lines.en: I pull my tentacles in short so the reef cannot snag them.

lines.zh: 上游的水更暖，我慢慢升上去。
lines.en: The water upstream is warmer, so I rise slowly.

lines.zh: 一只小虾在我伞下躲了一会儿。
lines.en: A little shrimp hides under my bell for a while.

lines.zh: 水底的沙一动，我就换了方向。
lines.en: When the sand shifts below, I change direction.
I hang still, brightening and dimming.

lines.zh: 没有脑子，但我还是会累。
lines.en: No brain, yet I still get tired.
Do jellyfish dream at all?

lines.zh: 我在数头顶飘过的气泡。
lines.en: I count the bubbles drifting overhead.

lines.zh: 星点在我伞上慢慢游走。
lines.en: Little stars crawl slowly across my bell.

lines.zh: 我等着水流替我决定方向。
lines.en: I wait for the current to pick my direction.

lines.zh: 深海的黑暗贴在我身上。
lines.en: The deep dark presses against my skin.

lines.zh: 我轻轻收伞，又轻轻张开。
lines.en: I close my bell softly, then open it.
This trench is cold as an ice cellar.
I hear a whale song, very far away.
One point of health would end me.
I drift and wait for the next warm current.
The coral's shadow is the safest place.
I hold nothing; I only drift.

lines.zh: 你把我头顶那点蓝光挡了。
lines.en: You blocked the last blue light above me.
Your shadow is bigger than this trench.
I turn to look at you, slowly.
Do you breathe water too?
My tentacles are reaching toward you.
Do not grab me; I will tear.

lines.zh: 你的衣服有干沙的味道。
lines.en: Your clothes smell of dry sand.
I watch you with my ring of eyes.

lines.zh: 你在发光，还是我的错觉？
lines.en: Are you glowing, or am I mistaken?
Come closer; I do not bite.
A crack runs across my bell.
The pain makes me pull in every tentacle.
I have one point of health; stop.
Water leaks in through the wound.
I cannot float straight; I am sinking.
Who touched me? I remember.
Two of my tentacles are gone.
The light dims, and it is mine.
I pull my bell in, trying to shrink.

lines.zh: 再挨一下，我就散成水了。
lines.en: One more blow and I scatter into water.
That warm current is calling me over.
Tiny drifting things are floating by.
I move toward the brightness.

lines.zh: 你把灯放在水里，我看见了。
lines.en: You put a light in the water; I saw it.
Something stirs deep in the cold trench.

lines.zh: 我不饿，可我还是想过去。
lines.en: I am not hungry, yet I want to go.
Are those bubbles meant for me?

lines.zh: 温暖浅滩离这里有多远？
lines.en: How far is the warm shallows?

lines.zh: 我朝你的手漂了一点点。
lines.en: I drift a little toward your hand.
When the current turns, I turn with it.
You knocked half my bell loose.
Your bump spun me in a circle.
Careful, I tear at a touch.
My tentacles are tangled on you.
You are too hard; I bounced off.
Move aside; I cannot stop drifting.

lines.zh: 这一下把我挤进珊瑚缝。
lines.en: That shoved me into a coral gap.
I did not mean to stick to you.
The water you stepped through is all churned.
Do not nudge me with your elbow.

lines.zh: 我在水里放出一串星点。
lines.en: I release a string of stars into the water.
Another jellyfish is waiting for me.

lines.zh: 我们的伞盖轻轻碰了一下。
lines.en: Our bells touched, very gently.

lines.zh: 这片海沟只够养一只小的。
lines.en: This trench can feed only one small one.
My glow is lit for that one.
Even cold water can hold young.
We rise side by side.
It is a ring smaller than me.
Do not watch; this is between us.

lines.zh: 散了以后，我们各漂一片沟。
lines.en: We part and drift into separate trenches.
I cannot hold anything at all.

lines.zh: 这块小石子从我触手里滑了。
lines.en: The pebble slipped from my tentacles.
I try to lift a shell.
It is heavy; I sank a little.
I balance it on top of my bell.
My tentacles let go and it falls.

lines.zh: 你掉的这枚，我能留着吗？
lines.en: May I keep this one you dropped?
I curl around a piece of seagrass.
I can carry this much weight.
The current washed my collection away.
Something kicks hard below me.

lines.zh: 那边水在翻，我飘过去看。
lines.en: The water churns over there; I drift to look.
Is it a fish, or you treading water?
My tentacles knew before I did.
That shadow is sinking.
I see a thread of blood spread.

lines.zh: 我懒得追，等它自己过来。
lines.en: I do not chase; let it come to me.
Something living entered my path.
A dull thud comes from the cold trench.
I have it marked, slowly.
I hang above it.

lines.zh: 它的尾巴一摆，我跟着歪。
lines.en: Its tail flicks, and I tilt with it.

lines.zh: 我的触手已经垂下去了。
lines.en: My tentacles are already lowered.
Do not struggle; faster means more tangled.
I wait for it to swim into my ring.
It has not seen me; good.
The water pushed me a little closer.
I count the beats of its heart.
I keep watch over this patch of water.
It cannot run; the current comes to me.
My tentacles sweep across it.
Just one touch; hold still.
It curled up, but too late.

lines.zh: 我的刺胞已经放出去了。
lines.en: My stinging cells are already fired.
I do not bite; I sting.
It thrashes beneath my bell.
This venom will numb it a while.
I sink and wrap around it.
Afterward I drift while digesting.
It breaks one corner free, then sticks again.

lines.zh: 我从冷沟的水里鼓出来。
lines.en: I swell out of the cold trench water.
I open my bell for the first time.
All around is dark but my glow.

lines.zh: 六片水域，我落在这一片。
lines.en: Six waters, and I landed in this one.
I am alone; no companion came.
The icy water makes me shiver.
I rise slowly, looking for light.
The coral reef spreads out below.

lines.zh: 我这么小，谁也不会注意。
lines.en: I am so small no one will notice.
A new jellyfish has begun.
Boiling water bleaches my bell white.
I was thrown from water onto stone.

lines.zh: 水灌满伞盖，我吸不到气。
lines.en: Water floods my bell and I cannot breathe.
The blast flung all of me away.

lines.zh: 一支箭从我伞盖上钻过去。
lines.en: An arrow drilled straight through my bell.
Something burns inside my bell.

lines.zh: 水里没有能填肚子的东西。
lines.en: There is nothing in the water to eat.

lines.zh: 雷劈进海面，我整只缩紧。
lines.en: Lightning hit the sea; I pulled myself tight.
I fell out of water into nothing.
